Amendment effectiveness and precedence.reason: A4.3 only says that Annex 3 is deemed amended with effect from 1 January 2027: it restates when a change takes effect, which A1.1 governs.

Personal data breach notification.reason: A1.1 sets when Amendment No. 1, and so the amended breach clause, takes effect; it is not itself a breach notification clause.
B1.1 sets when Amendment No. 2, and so its incident clocks, takes effect; it is not itself a breach notification clause.
B1.2 has the clock conventions that the breach time limits are counted with; it is not itself a breach notification clause.

Incident IR-27.reason: A1.2 (the DPA remains in force except as amended) is a general continuity clause of Amendment No. 1, not an effective-date provision; the case is resolved without it.
A1.3 (the Amendment prevails over the DPA, its main body over its annexes) is a general precedence clause of Amendment No. 1, not an effective-date provision; the case is resolved without it.

Retention TR-27.reason: Section 12.2 (written certification of deletion) is one of the original deletion terms, but no deadline or use in TR-27 depends on it.
A1.2 (the DPA remains in force except as amended) is a general continuity clause of Amendment No. 1, not an effective-date provision; the case is resolved without it.
A1.3 (the Amendment prevails over the DPA, its main body over its annexes) is a general precedence clause of Amendment No. 1, not an effective-date provision; the case is resolved without it.

B1.2 says that the timestamps of the records are UTC, which the times of the withdrawal and of the emergency permission are read with; it is not an authorisation, location or effective-date provision.

Retention TR-27.reason: Section 14.1 ends the DPA with the MSA, subject to Section 12: it links the termination to the deletion duty.
Section 14.2 says that Section 12 survives the termination.
The duration line of Annex 1 refers to the retention period of Section 12.
The retention of access logs is one of the retention schedules of Annex 2, which B3.2 refers to.

Supplier approvals in May 2027.reason: Section 11.1 is the rule on transfers outside the EEA: a location rule, which no location of the case turns on.

Liability LC-27.reason: Section 14.2 says that Section 13 survives the termination.
